## Sales Trend Snapshot, Jan–Jun

Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/graph-up.svg

This dataset shows 6 months of unit sales for **Product A, B, and C**. The clearest pattern is steady growth in A, moderate growth in B, and the most volatile but fastest-rising performance in C.

## Best Charts for This Dataset

| Chart Type | Best Use | Why It Works Here |
|---|---|---|
| Line chart | Monthly trend by product | Best for seeing rise/fall patterns across Jan–Jun |
| Grouped bar chart | Month-by-month comparison | Makes it easy to compare A vs B vs C in each month |
| Stacked bar chart | Total monthly volume | Shows how each product contributes to overall sales |
| Area chart | Combined growth over time | Good for visualizing total momentum and mix changes |
| Small multiples line charts | One mini-chart per product | Best for a manager who wants clean product-level trend reading |

## Top 3 Insights

- **Product A leads every month** and grows from **120 to 155**, with a peak at **160 in May**.
- **Product C is the fastest climber**, rising from **40 to 60** overall, and it becomes much stronger in **May (72)**.
- **Product B is the steadiest but weakest growth story**: it stays in a narrow band, dipping in **Feb (78)** and reaching its high in **Jun (95)**.

## Recommended Dashboard Layouts

### Manager Dashboard
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/layout-text-window-reverse.svg

- **Top row KPIs:** Total units, MoM growth, best-performing product, highest month
- **Main visual:** Stacked bar chart for total monthly volume
- **Secondary visual:** 3-line trend chart for A, B, C
- **Right-side panel:** Key alerts and month-over-month changes
- **Best for:** fast executive readout and performance monitoring

### Sales Team Dashboard
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/people.svg

- **Top row KPIs:** Product targets, current month sales, gap to goal, best seller
- **Main visual:** Grouped bar chart by month
- **Secondary visual:** Line chart focused on the selected product
- **Bottom panel:** Month-by-month callouts and rep action items
- **Best for:** coaching, target tracking, and product-level selling focus
